# ffxf_vm_metrics (Data Source)

Reads time-series CPU, memory, disk, and network metrics for a virtual machine.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_vm_metrics" "example" {
  vm_id     = 123
  timeframe = "day"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vm_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the virtual machine.

### Optional

- `timeframe` (String) Metrics range: hour, day, week, month, or year. Defaults to hour.

### Read-Only

- `series` (Attributes List) Time-series samples. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--series))
- `step_seconds` (Number) Time interval represented by each metric point.

<a id="nestedatt--series"></a>
### Nested Schema for `series`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (Number) Share of allotted vCPU, from 0 to 1.
- `disk_read_bytes` (Number) Disk read bytes.
- `disk_write_bytes` (Number) Disk write bytes.
- `memory_bytes` (Number) Memory usage in bytes.
- `net_in_bytes` (Number) Inbound network bytes.
- `net_out_bytes` (Number) Outbound network bytes.
- `time` (String) Sample timestamp.
